frontmatter.name: ios-to-android
frontmatter.description: Use for ANY task that ports or implements Android functionality from an iOS/Swift codebase — including single-feature tasks (BLE scanning, location/GPS tracking, billing, Health Connect, background work, database, one screen), not just full-app migrations. Primary coordinating skill for migrating iOS apps and subsystems to Android (Jetpack Compose, Room, Kotlin Coroutines and Flow, Architecture Components). Handles both full-app greenfield migrations and scoped sub-component feature migrations: Info.plist p
